css:
/* Keep the complete day count and its unit together inside the calendar. */
.countdown-value{position:absolute;left:25%;top:19%;width:52%;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:center;gap:2cqw}.countdown-value .number{position:static;margin:0;flex:none;font-size:calc(43cqw / var(--countdown-digits,1));line-height:1}.countdown-value .days{position:static;margin:0;flex:none;line-height:1}
